issues: Verdict KNOWN upheld: the step is (sum a_i)^r <= sum a_i^r for 0<r<=1 (||a||_1 <= ||a||_r), textbook; proof correct; do not present as new. Both confirmed citations fetched and correct: ongie2026representation (arXiv 2606.14954, Ongie & Parhi, Jun 2026; Prop 3.6, Def 3.11/Prop 3.13, Sec.8 'subadditivity follows by concatenating neurons', Lemma 9.2/Thm 9.3 (2/L)-seminorm all verified in PDF) and gunasekar2018implicit (NeurIPS 31, 2018; l_{2/L} bridge penalty in frequency domain; optionally add volume 31). Caveat on the proposed wording: Ongie-Parhi's subadditivity is function-level, from concatenating neurons (merged cost <= sum of costs, an upper bound), with the exponent from homogeneity; the paper's step is the lower bound (parameter cost >= l_r quasi-norm of amplitudes). Replace 'This is the subadditivity that makes ... p-norms' with 'the same p-normed geometry appears in weight-decay representation costs of deep/product parametrisations'. Kalton-Peck-Roberts, An F-space Sampler bib data now confirmed on Cambridge Core (LMS LNS 89, CUP 1984, DOI 10.1017/CBO9780511662447); specific lemma not read, so it is fine as a generic p-normed-space reference only. No further prior art found, but searching was limited: WebSearch returned 'this session has used its web search budget (200 of 200 WebSearch calls)'.
